company.shortDescription: Repertoire Immune Medicines is a clinical stage biotechnology company.
company.description: Repertoire Immune Medicines is a clinical stage biotechnology company working to unleash the human immune system to prevent, treat or cure cancer, autoimmune conditions and infectious diseases. The company is currently conducting experimental medicine clinical trials using autologous T cells primed against cancer antigens and tethered to IL-15.

items.description: Repertoire Immune Medicines has entered into a collaboration and license agreement with Genentech to discover and develop T cell-targeted therapies for autoimmune diseases. Repertoire will use its DECODE platform for target discovery, while Genentech will handle preclinical, clinical development, and commercialization. The agreement includes $35 million upfront and up to $730 million in milestone payments, plus tiered royalties for Repertoire.

aiResearchSummary.text: Repertoire Immune Medicines is engaged in developing immunostimulatory fusion molecules that combine an immune cell targeting moiety with a cytokine molecule. These compositions are designed for pharmaceutical applications and involve specific methods for their use and formulation. Additionally, the company is exploring the use of reversible linkers in protein therapeutics, focusing on their preparation and delivery. These areas of research highlight the company's focus on innovative approaches to immune modulation and therapeutic delivery.
